question: Which one is not the festival of Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunburn Festival**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sunburn Festival is an electronic dance music festival held in India.
 
• It is primarily associated with the state of Goa, where it was first held in 2007.
 
• Sunburn has grown to become one of Asia's largest music festivals.
 
• It attracts international artists and a large audience from around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttarayan Kite Festival**

 
 
• Uttarayan, also known as the International Kite Festival, is celebrated every year in Gujarat.
 
• It marks the day when winter begins to turn into summer, according to the Indian calendar.
 
• People celebrate by flying kites and organizing kite competitions.
 
• The festival is particularly famous in the city of Ahmedabad.
 
 
 
• **Kutch Festival**
 
 
• The Kutch Festival, also known as Rann Utsav, is a cultural festival held in the Kutch region of Gujarat.
 
• It showcases the art, music, dance, crafts, and cuisine of the region.
 
• The festival usually takes place in the winter months from November to February.
 
• Tourists can enjoy the vibrant cultural activities and the picturesque white desert of the Rann of Kutch.
 
 
 
• **Paragliding Festival**
 
 
• The Paragliding Festival in Gujarat is an adventure sports event.
 
• It is usually organized in the Saputara region, known for its hilly terrain.
 
• The festival aims to promote tourism and adventure sports in the state.
 
• Enthusiasts from various parts of the country participate in paragliding and other adventure activities.
